prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Pet's Origin", "Select a ready-to-play companion or create a custom pet from your photos.", "Select Creation Path"]
1: ["How to Interact With Your Desktop Pet", "Learn the basic shortcuts to summon, hide, and interact with your new companion anytime.", "Got It, Let's Go!", "Quick Shortcut: Alt + Pet Click", "Drag to move • Double-click to talk • Right-click menu to hide"]
2: ["Define Your Pet's Personality", "Choose key traits to tailor how your pet behaves on your desktop.", "Save Traits", "Playful, Calm, Curious, Energetic"]
3: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe", "Your companion data and customization will automatically sync across devices.", "Using the same account restores all existing pets instantly.", "Cloud Save Active: No Pet Progress Lost"]
4: ["If your pet doesn't appear immediately, check system tray overflow or multi-monitor settings.", "Tips: Ensure display scaling is set to standard and overlay permissions are allowed."]
5: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Provide 1-3 well-lit photos for optimal 3D desktop pet rendering.", "Select Photos", "Front angle photo • Good lighting • Single subject"]
6: ["Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Look at the bottom right of your main screen or system tray icon to interact, adjust settings, or manage your pet.", "Meet My Pet Now"]
7: ["What Kind of Desktop Companion Do You Want?", "Answer 1 quick question to find your perfect onboarding match.", "See Recommended Path", "Instant Classic Pet vs Custom Photo Rebirth"]
8: ["Generating Your Pet in the Background", "You can safely minimize this window. We will notify you when your pet is ready!"]
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Stamp your certificate and confirm your pet's desktop registration.", "Certified Desktop Companion", "Stamp Certificate"]
